entries.title: A short answer at the end of a card's thread stays in view on your iPhone
entries.body: On your iPhone, a short first mate answer at the end of a card's thread could still slip under the card's lower edge, with the jump down arrow in its place, when the message box below grew to show the same answer. A thread you are reading at its end now stays at its end.
entries.noPicture: The thread looks as it did; only a short answer that was sometimes hidden under the card's edge now stays in view.
